title: Tashbihi (Theme 10: Kukabiliana na uhalifu)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child links the quality to the thing that has it most (mrefu kama twiga, mnene kama tembo) and keeps "kama".
representations: pictures of a giraffe, an elephant, a thin stick
steps: Find the thing that has it most.

board.say: Ni mnyama yupi ni mnene sana?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "mnene kama tembo" and one more simile of height.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mtu mrefu sana ni mrefu kama ___." Kwa nini "sungura" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Tashbihi hutumia ulinganisho wa kawaida: mrefu kama twiga, mnene kama kiboko, mkubwa kama ndovu.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni tashbihi ipi?" Kwa nini "Yeye ni twiga" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Tashbihi hulinganisha kwa kutumia kama: mrefu kama twiga. "Yeye ni twiga" ni sitiari.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: ""Baba ni mrefu kama twiga" maana yake nini?" Kwa nini "Baba ni twiga" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Tashbihi inaelezea kwa kulinganisha. "Mrefu kama twiga" ina maana mtu ni mrefu sana.

misconceptions.ask: Mnyama huyu ni mrefu au mfupi?
misconceptions.repair: Twiga ni mrefu, kwa hiyo tunasema mrefu kama twiga.

checks.question: Ni ipi ni tashbihi: "Yeye ni twiga" au "Ni mrefu kama twiga"?
